desc: Ideation: reduce the problem to maximum bottleneck path queries on the grid and choose a Kruskal reconstruction tree / LCA approach.
Implement the complete Python solution using a Kruskal reconstruction tree with compact arrays, fast input parsing, and efficient LCA preprocessing.
Validate the implementation on the sample and edge cases: single-cell grid, same block with different floors, B larger than both floors, B=1, and large input/output volume.
